tagline: Consumer electronics and services: iPhone, Mac, iPad, Wearables, and a high-margin Services business.

fundamentals.asOf: TTM through Q3 FY2026 (ended Jun 27, 2026); prices as of Oct 7, 2026 close
notes: Q3 FY26 company gross margin of 50.1% included ~2 percentage points from tariff refunds; diluted EPS included a $0.11 benefit from the same.
Installed base of active devices reached a new all-time high across all major product categories (company).

calls.text: Consensus Buy across 44 analysts; average target $330.02 (−4.0% vs the Oct 26 close)
Next earnings: Mon, Nov 2, 2026 (Apple IR / MacRumors)

catalysts.event: Q4 FY2026 earnings (covers iPhone 18 Pro launch week)
Holiday quarter guide and memory-cost commentary on the Nov 2 call

bull.text: Services (~$30.7B in Q3, +12% YoY) and high installed base support recurring, high-margin revenue
iPhone (+22%) and Mac (+29%) both grew double digits in Q3 FY26
TTM free cash flow of $136.7B funds buybacks (shares outstanding −2.13% YoY) and a growing dividend

bear.text: Valuation is rich at ~38× trailing earnings with the average Street target slightly below the current price
Rising DRAM/NAND costs are a stated margin headwind beyond the September quarter (Q3 call)
Hardware still ~70% of revenue; China, FX and supply constraints can swing a quarter
Regulatory and App Store pressure on Services remains an ongoing risk

news.title: Apple's foldable iPhone Duo hits stores with a $2,000 price tag and scarce supply
news.summary: Demand was strong but sales were rationed (two per customer; pickup-only in China, France, Hong Kong, India and Japan), and delivery dates had slipped to late January. Reviews praised the hinge but flagged camera compromises; IDC expects Apple to take 44% of foldable market value in 2026 and lead in units by 2027. AAPL closed down 0.1%.

news.title: iPhone Duo hits stores with short supply and lines outside Apple Stores
news.summary: Apple's first foldable ($2,000 and up, to $3,199 for 2TB) goes on sale Friday; new online orders now show end-of-January delivery. The Duo is built in a limited number of facilities in China. Apple reports fiscal Q4 on Nov. 2, a quarter that won't include Duo sales.

news.title: Morgan Stanley sees a 'slightly challenging' setup for Apple's report; iPhone Duo walk-in supply limited
news.summary: Morgan Stanley kept Overweight and a $355 target but expects December-quarter guidance slightly below the Street. Apple said stores will have only limited iPhone Duo units for walk-ins at Friday's Oct. 23 launch after online preorders sold out within minutes, pushing some deliveries into January 2027. Apple reports fiscal Q4 on Nov. 2.

news.title: Loop Capital downgrades Apple to Hold and cuts its target to $330 from $370
news.summary: Loop's supply-chain checks show Apple has no plans to recover the 13 million iPhone shipments cut in the second half of 2026; it models 79M December-quarter units vs the Street's 85M, flagged gross-margin risk from rising memory costs, and lowered normalized EPS to $11 from $12.

news.title: UBS stays Neutral with a $296 target as Apple expands US manufacturing partnerships
news.summary: UBS expects September-quarter revenue of $112.8B ($56B iPhone) and iPhone growth slowing to 14% with margin pressure. Apple committed up to $100M over three years to titanium supplier Perryman for the iPhone Duo and expanded its partnership with Qnity Electronics; it reports fiscal Q4 on Nov. 2.

news.title: Jefferies says iPhone 18 Pro demand weakness is 'intensifying', citing zero China lead times
news.summary: Jefferies' Edison Lee said iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max lead times in China have fallen to zero (vs. 6 and 25 days a year ago), PDD began discounting them 6–9% on Oct. 16, and Apple has cut some component orders, including 2nm chips, by 10–15%. Duo lead times stretched past 90 days, implying at most 6–7 million 2026 shipments. AAPL closed down 0.15% at $342.94.

news.title: KeyBanc reiterates Underweight and a $250 target after an iPhone upgrade survey
news.summary: A KeyBanc survey of 2,046 iPhone users (Sept. 19–Oct. 6) suggests upgrades will moderate as prices rise, carrier promotions tighten and existing phones remain adequate, which the firm says would also slow services growth. It notes Apple trades at about 40 times its 2027 earnings estimate versus a three-year average near 27.

news.title: JPMorgan reiterates Overweight and a $360 target, citing iPhone Duo lead times
news.summary: JPMorgan said Duo delivery estimates already stretching into next year suggest demand has exceeded its revised 8–9 million-unit 2026 estimate, while iPhone 18 Pro Max lead times are back in line with last year. UBS kept Neutral and a $296 target on Oct. 16, warning shorter iPhone 18 Pro waits could signal softer demand.

news.title: Apple's $1,999 iPhone Duo sells out in minutes; deliveries slip to late January
news.summary: Preorders for Apple's first foldable opened at 8 a.m. ET on Oct. 16 and estimated delivery moved past the Oct. 23 launch within minutes, reaching late January by the afternoon. Apple called demand 'nothing short of extraordinary' but gave no preorder count. The backlog could shift some Duo revenue from the holiday quarter into March. AAPL rose 0.43% to $343.46 in a broad tech selloff.

news.title: Evercore ISI calls Apple a top defensive play amid the AI sell-off
news.summary: Evercore ISI analyst Amit Daryanani named Apple a top defensive name as the market debates AI stocks. AAPL rose 0.4% to $343.46 on Friday while the Nasdaq fell 2.1%.

news.title: Apple and Meta team up to run Meta's Muse Spark Open AI model on Mac Studios
news.summary: In a rare partnership between the rivals, Meta's 816-billion-parameter open-weight model is tuned to run locally across two to four M5 Ultra Mac Studios, which CNBC said signals Apple's growing strength in AI chips. AAPL closed down 0.3% at $342.00.

news.title: Apple closes above a $5 trillion market value for the first time
news.summary: AAPL rose 0.5% to $342.96 on a down day for tech, ending at about $5.005 trillion and becoming the second company after Nvidia to close above the mark; it was the only Magnificent Seven stock higher on the day.
